name: HOLMES
summary: HOLMES determines neutrino mass from the endpoint of holmium-163 electron capture measured inside cryogenic calorimeters. Its first array result demonstrates an approach that can be scaled through multiplexed detector readout.
detection_principle: Holmium is ion-implanted into absorbers coupled to transition-edge sensors. Each pixel measures all de-excitation energy except that carried by the neutrino; microwave multiplexing reads out many low-temperature sensors.

science_scope: This is a laboratory kinematic measurement of the effective electron-flavour neutrino mass. Its observable differs from the effective Majorana mass in neutrinoless double-beta decay and the sum of neutrino masses inferred from cosmology.
